profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack & Cloud Engineering | Fintech & Insurance
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer with 5+ years of experience building and modernizing web platforms in fintech and insurance. I specialize in React and TypeScript on the frontend and Node.js/Express on the backend, with hands-on experience architecting Azure cloud infrastructure, leading partner integrations, and driving platform-wide engineering standards.
 
 
I'm always open to connecting with engineers, engineering leaders, and teams building ambitious products.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Architected a backend platform overhaul consolidating 16 Azure Functions into two TypeScript/Express API services, eliminating 32+ Azure resources and 16 Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and introduced ESLint, Prettier, and Swagger as engineering standards adopted across the team.
 
Extended a React-based insurance form platform with configurable, data-driven rule engine capabilities, including on-demand validation, conditional logic, and form versioning with one-click rollback, enabling business teams to deploy and revert changes without engineering support.
 
Owned full-stack development of two insurance partner integrations, including an end-to-end vacant building proof of concept presented to leadership, and led code reviews and technical design discussions across the team in an Agile/Scrum environment.
 
Drove innovation sprints producing a GraphQL/FastAPI/Cosmos DB proof of concept, Terraform infrastructure-as-code for Azure provisioning, and Application Insights instrumentation for frontend analytics, directly informing future platform architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
(Previously Rotella Capital Management)

Engineered modular, reusable React component architecture for a fintech SaaS platform that cut feature development time by 40% and contributed directly to a 15% increase in monthly paid subscriptions.
 
Migrated nearly 100% of the codebase from JavaScript to TypeScript, eliminating a broad class of runtime errors and establishing stronger type safety standards across the platform.
 
Maintained Jest test coverage across components and partnered with UI/UX, QA, and product leadership to ship responsive web features on a rapid release cadence.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built and deployed multiple automated financial data pipelines as Windows services in C#, reducing manual processing overhead and improving data reliability for live trading operations.
 
Reduced team debugging time by 40% by developing a custom log parsing and analysis tool, adopted immediately across the engineering team.
 
Integrated 5+ investment firms and external data providers into the trading platform using C#/.NET, expanding the firm's data coverage and supporting broader trading operations.

positions.title: Computer Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Designed and developed a Python/OpenCV-based 2D visualization and LiDAR control program, cutting hardware debugging time by 25% through real-time sensor data analytics.
 
Built a semi-automated laser testing system using an Arduino microcontroller and custom Python UI, enabling precise and repeatable target movement along a custom track and cutting testing time by 50%+.

projects.title: 3D Mapping with LiDAR
projects.description: This University of Washington Bothell capstone project involved the design and implementation of a system where a user can capture 360° scans of an indoor environment in 3D using a MicroVision LiDAR sensor. The user can view the result in our custom-built website or their own point cloud viewer. Our industrial sponsor, MicroVision, had recently begun to market their new indoor LiDAR sensors and they wanted a system that they can use to show potential customers the capabilities of their new LiDAR. Our project included writing software to process, filter, stitch, and view the data. Our prototype processed the data from the sensor and displayed it on the website. A rotating platform was implemented to autonomously rotate the sensor 360° to capture data hands-free. A system to portably power the system was also designed. Our prototype is operated wirelessly through the ‘cloud’.
